notes: FROZEN — no phases. agy 1.1.18 does raise blocking dialogs that name no tool call: the first-use workspace trust gate ('Do you trust the contents of this project?', answered into ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json's trustedWorkspaces, 47 entries on this host, and auto-dismissed by irrlicht's own driver because it BLOCKS the REPL until answered) and server-driven MCP elicitation (ElicitationInteractionSpec{server_name,mode,message,requested_schema_json,url} in the RequestedInteraction oneof, elicitation/create, both form and url modes). The sandbox/network-access confirmation also exists but is carried by the tool call that wanted the escape (PermissionInteractionSpec + PermissionInteraction.sandbox_override, grant action unsandboxed(*)), so it belongs to tool-gate-permission-prompt / permission-gate-non-mutating-tool, not here; the auto-mode/settings-review shape has no confirmable trigger (ApprovalInteractionSpec is an empty message). None of it is observable. The trust gate blocks BEFORE agy mints the conversation dir and transcript.jsonl, so no session row exists to move to waiting — the adapter is transcript-first (FilesUnderRoot keyed on the <conv-id> brain directory). And no dialog of any kind is written as a step: across the 103 real CLI conversations on this host transcript.jsonl carries only USER_INPUT / PLANNER_RESPONSE / MODEL tool results / SYSTEM {EPHEMERAL_MESSAGE, CHECKPOINT, CONVERSATION_HISTORY, SYSTEM_MESSAGE, ERROR_MESSAGE} — there is no interaction, elicitation or approval step type — parser.go skips every SYSTEM step, and the one branch it does read keys on a PLANNER_RESPONSE's tool_calls, which a tool-less dialog by definition lacks. No hook can carry it either: installedHookEvents is [Stop] alone, and PreToolUse (excluded on the #1719 hazard) is a tool event. The only place a tool-less waiting episode is recorded is the sibling SQLite store, whose steps.status is agy's CortexStepStatus with a dedicated CORTEX_STEP_STATUS_WAITING = 9 — but that store is opened on turn_done for tokens and the model, never watched, so reaching it live is a new Source rather than a rule change. Re-assess when agy persists a pending interaction into transcript.jsonl, or when the adapter gains a polled Source over conversations/<conv>.db.
